text:
Rae: emergency DIY question  made a coffee-table fort because my upstairs neighbor decided to test every power tool at once. mic + laptop are inside the fort. will this be peak professionalism? :coffee: :fort:
Omar: love the commitment. coffee-table fort is peak engineering. line it with pillows or a thick blanket to dampen mid/high frequencies. avoid sealing it completely so heat doesn't build up.
Lina: also shove the mic onto a pile of socks or a pillow so desk thumps don't transfer. put your laptop on a stand so air circulation keeps it cool.
Rae: noted. my cat immediately claimed the fort as sacred territory though  sending hostage picture in 2.
Greg: obligatory cat cameo requirement accepted. also, quick networking note: my upload spiked weirdly earlier. did a speedtest mid-call: ```
Ping: 19 ms
Download: 4.3 Mbps
Upload: 1.2 Mbps
```
Rae: ouch download low but upload survivable. still laggy for screen share. neighbor is leaf-blower-ing the patio now so might need failover.
Omar: if you have a phone with decent LTE/5G, tether as a hotspot during the meeting. pro tip: enable airplane mode briefly then re-enable cellular to force 4G/5G handoff if it's sticky.
Lina: small travel router in AP mode between ISP modem and your wifi can give you more control/QoS. Greg: is 1.2 upl enough for a clean Zoom?
Greg: depends on resolution/frame rate. for one-way screen share + camera at 720p, 1.2 might be marginal. better to drop camera or share slides only.
connectivity-bot: Provider advisory: brief spike/outage reported earlier in your area (Ticket #SPK-2026-551). Monitor status page for updates.
Rae: of course provider had a drama episode. BRB making a pillow throne and negotiating with the cat. will report back with photo + results (and possibly a heroic phone-tether).
Omar: status update plan: 1) pillow-lining, 2) mic-sock, 3) laptop-stand, 4) hot-spot rescue. Also, if you need a travel AP, I have one to loan for a week  DM me.
Lina: PS: if you decide to go camera-off, use a funny background in chat to signal "vacuuming neighbor" without awkward verbal explanation.
Rae: note taken. pillow throne in progress. mandatory cat hostage pic uploaded  community standards satisfied. thanks y'all  will post an after photo and whether the leaf blower bowed to the fort.
